releaseNotes: Fixed: the per-box hover menu (photo search, crop, replace, delete) was invisible on 'photo-cards' style rows, including the new Store Circular category rows -- it was opening, just clipped off-screen by the box's own border. New: each product row now has a '+ Add box' tile at the end, and each box's hover menu has a 'remove box' option -- add or remove items from any row instead of being stuck with the template's original count.
